item.title: ‘The 99’ers’: Emilia Jones & Alessandro Nivola Join Netflix’s US Women’s Soccer Drama
item.description: Who else will join Zoey Deutch and Emily Bader on Netflix‘s “The 99’ers,” the streamer’s drama about the 1999 US Women’s National Soccer team? Deadline reports that Emilia Jones and Alessandro Nivola are the latest to join the cast. Jones will play US team member Julie Foudy in the film, while Nivola is Tony DiCicco, the team’s head coach from 1994-1999.
